verdict.rationale: Grok is driven through a documented public API. The REST API is OpenAI-compatible, and a gRPC API exposes the same models and services. A probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai/openapi.json, and llms.txt is also published. The docs cover self-serve API keys with runnable first requests, a GET /v1/models catalog endpoint, rate limits, and a Management API for programmatic team administration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end (community items discuss model quality, not the API surface).
